src.title: Cherry Garcia Protein Ice Cream Creami Recipe

recipes.title: Cherry Garcia Protein Creami (Ben & Jerry's Copycat)

items.i: jarred Bing cherries, stemmed, opened and blotted dry on paper towel
Hershey's dark chocolate, chopped into ⅛-inch chunks

steps: In a tall container add the cherry juice, milk, egg yolks and vanilla. Mix the protein, Swerve, salt and xanthan gum, then blend them in slowly over 30 seconds and blend 90 seconds more.
Pour into a pint, label and freeze 24 hours.
Open the cherries and press them into a triple layer of paper towel to remove the juice (otherwise it turns icy).
Run the pint under hot water 1 minute and spin on Sorbet (the thickest result).
Make a hole in the middle and layer chocolate and cherries until all are in, put the scooped ice cream back and run Mix-in.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video's narration. Cheaper swap: 100 g pitted Rainier cherries tossed with 10 g sugar for 30 minutes, then blotted. He says it's about half the calories of the original pint; he doesn't give macros, so they're estimates.
